scenario: The ego vehicle executes a left turn at a 4-way intersection while an adversarial vehicle approaches from the opposite direction.

ego.behavior: The car turns left at the intersection and yields to oncoming traffic.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward through the intersection from the opposite direction.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle starts on the southbound approach of a 4-way intersection, positioned to turn left, while the adversarial vehicle approaches on the east-west cross street from the right side of the ego's path.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must yield to the adversarial vehicle traveling straight through the intersection; the scenario terminates once the ego completes its left turn or a collision occurs.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the centered car from first-person perspective; one adversarial car exists. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial car. 3. Chronology: initial both approach intersection; midpoint ego initiates left turn while adversarial proceeds straight; ending ego completes turn or yields. 4. Evidence: arrow indicates left turn path; pink dot shows adversarial position on cross street.
